content: Ungö apan mɛ kàmɛn un'tö a un'kɔk wàmuduub inyɛm kyàtàtwɛb, mɛ kàwem umwɛy uboo a ikyeer a mɔ̈ɔ̈ kan'tɛn u ndaa a idum: « Yà! »
In'kàler, kyekà mpoonà a pɛɛl kàkäl. Mbuur kàlär udu a wa kàkäl anà utà. Ba bun'pɛ mpà a imfum. Nde kàkyen wàŋàböŋ ntɔn mukàwal iböŋ.
Mpal kàduub un'tö a un'kɔk inyɛm kyàyweel, mɛ kàwem ikyeer kyàyweel kyan'tɛn naa: « Yà! »
Apan mpoonà asin wàŋɔɔ waa kàyàtoo. Mbuur kàlär udu a wa bun'pɛ ikɔ̈b mugyɔɔr duu a mɛɛn ntɔn baar bàküküül mbɛy. Ba bun'pɛ kɔm a kölàköl.
Mpal kàduub un'tö a un'kɔk inyɛm kyàtär, mɛ kàwem ikyeer kyàtär kyan'tɛn naa: « Yà! » In'kàler, mpoonà a piil kàyàtoo. Mbuur kàlär udu a wa kàkäl anà undiir musi buur u kɔɔ ande.
Mɛ kàwem asànaa ndaa uboboo a ikyeer a mɔ̈ɔ̈ byànà yàmutɛn naa: « Kilɔ mwɛy kyà blɛ ntɔn làfur a ilä mwɛy, bilɔ itär byà orze ntɔn làfur a ilä mwɛy. Wɛɛ twon an'ba may anà vin. »
Mpal kàduub un'tö a un'kɔk inyɛm kyànà, mɛ kàwem ikyeer a mɔ̈ɔ̈ kyànà kyan'tɛn naa: « Yà! »

In'kàler, mpoonà wà an'dà a sakàsak mà kakaa kan'yàtoo. Mbuur kàlär udu awa ikɔb ande « ukwà ». An'lɔŋ màkyer ayun'swà. Ba bapɛ ikɔ̈b udu a yar làmwɛy unsà an'yar an'nà mà mɛɛn, ntɔn mudwa baar a kɔm, a ngyal, a fway anà a ntsür a nkyɛl a mɛɛn.
Mpal kàduub un'tö a un'kɔk inyɛm kyàtyeen, mɛ kàwem ungyɛl a mɛsà a ibɔɔn akɔl a baar bàdwä ntɔn ndaa a Nzam anà imbäl bàkäl ba akyà.
Ba bàsi in'kwɛŋ u ndaa a ngwal: « Un'lɔɔŋ in'kyɛɛl anà wàndandaa, mpal nà ngye asàtsul nsaŋ anà asàfuur mfuur a an'kil abi akà baar a mɛɛn? »
Apan, bàpɛ mvwɛl a pɛɛl akà umwɛy umwɛy uboo a ba anà bàtɛn a ba naa ba bàkäŋ mpem ikye tii mpal usàkwo un'taŋ a baar wanswà kàsäl aba ikal imwɛy anà wà atɔŋ aba abà badwä asànaa ba.
Ungö apan, mpal kàduub un'tö a un'kɔk inyɛm kyàsyaam, mɛɛn màkyer atɛɛr a ngwal, taaŋ làbulà làpiil asànaa ngɔɔr bàkyer a in'kà a ntsür, nsöŋ wanswà kàbulà asànaa an'kil.
Mbwaar yàfü du yàbü u mɛɛn, asànaa un'pöb a kölàköl kan'ni un'te a fige waa an'fige man'bwà.
Du làkyer ayaalà asànaa un'kaan aŋàdiŋà, myɔŋ myanswà anà isaŋ byàkäl byàŋàlwomà kà ikal abya.
Amfum a mɛɛn, abyääl, amfum a aŋità, aŋin'naaŋ, aŋangwal, baar banswà, asɔ anà baar a nsaay, bàkàyee uboo a mɔɔ anà uboo a nkɔŋ u myɔŋ.
Ba bàtɛɛnà a myɔŋ anà nkɔŋ naa: « Làbü udu a bi, lifwee kusà a mbuur kan'bwaay udu a kir imwol anà kusà a nkyɛl a un'tö a un'kɔk.
Ntɔn ilä a kölàköl kyà nkyɛl aba kyan'kwo. Nà kan'kwo mutsim? »
